“Arun did not die — he became a symbol of the spirit of the Indian soldier.”
— Field Marshal Sam Manekshaw (reported remark on his bravery)

My grandfather was a tank commander and was martyred in the 1971 war — a great artist as well. Though I never met him, I feel his spirit lives through my art. Every stroke I paint is a tribute to him. The movie Ikkis is not just a film — it’s for families like ours, who carry the legacy and pride of 1971 in their hearts.

I am writing this complete story after receiving so many comments.

My grandfather served in the Deccan Horse regiment. During a fierce battle, while he was in his tank, a call for help came from another tank operator who was badly injured and needed immediate medical aid.

My grandfather wanted to help him, but his fellow tank members advised him not to open the hatch as there was heavy firing from both sides. But how could he leave a comrade behind? A Rajput by blood never abandons someone in need.

He opened the hatch, returned fire at the enemy, and in the crossfire, he was martyred while saving another soldier’s life.
He left behind four children — three daughters and one son — and a brave, warm-hearted widow at the age of just 35.

His story reminds me that courage runs in the blood, and sacrifice builds the legacy.

Just imagine the temperament of a 21 year old boy who was hit by shells in his face before he destroyed 3 tanks, then cleaned his wounded face blood dripping through his  eyes then he destroyed 2 more tanks. Then died because his tank was also hit by enemy tanks. Ultimate courage and sacrifice for country 🇮🇳. Paramveer chakra.

Just for information -
Many Indian soldiers have died at age 21, with prominent examples including Second Lieutenant Arun Khetarpal, a Param Vir Chakra recipient in the 1971 war, and Rifleman Jaswant Singh Rawat, a Maha Vir Chakra awardee from the 1962 Sino-Indian War, both known for immense bravery at a young age. More recently, soldiers like Agniveer Akashdeep Singh (d. 2025) and Sepoy Ankush Thakur (d. 2020) also made the ultimate sacrifice at 21, highlighting the recurring theme of youthful valor in India's defense history.
